summary.text: Ryan Teasdale is the Green Party candidate on the November ballot for Michigan's 11th District. A nonprofit professional who left a corporate career, he describes his campaign as centered on disagreeing more respectfully, affordable housing, transparency and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Teasdale graduated from Waterford Mott High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Oakland University in 2009.
His career experience includes working as a nonprofit professional.
In his Ballotpedia survey he says he left a corporate career last year and started a group that demonstrates the benefits of disagreeing more respectfully.
The Green Party nominated him at its April 25, 2026 convention.
